visual_identity.core_identity: A living cave predator whose broad leathery body resembles a hanging cloak until it unfolds into a manta-like creature.
visual_identity.silhouette: Wide triangular mantle body with winglike sides, narrow trailing tail, and compact underside face.
visual_identity.head_features: Small predatory underside face integrated into the mantle rather than mounted on a neck.
visual_identity.body_shape: Flat flexible ray-like body with broad leathery wings and one long whip-like tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No humanoid limbs; broad mantle edges function as wings and one long tail trails behind. When hanging, visible contact supports the body.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth leathery membrane with sparse folds and rib lines.

accuracy_checks: reads as a living cloak rather than bat

known_failure_modes.correction: restore broad cloak-like mantle, integrated underside face, and long tail

known_failure_modes.symptom: hanging cloaker has no attachment or support
known_failure_modes.correction: show visible wall/ceiling contact or grounded unfolding posture
remove extra tentacles and restore single tail plus mantle wings

scene_identity.size_impression: Large broad mantle whose width dominates more than body thickness.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Hanging flush against wall or ceiling, draped over a surface, or flying with broad mantle fully readable.
behavior_style: peeling away from a wall or ceiling
environment_fit: large stone surfaces where cloak-like camouflage reads
